analysis.scoreReasonEn: RSI up from 44.8 to 51.0, MACD histogram improving

analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 44.8 to 51.0, confirming exit from oversold territory. MACD histogram also improved from 2.1240 to 5.3215, strengthening the uptrend. Five consecutive positive candlesticks are forming, and the current price of $151.03 relative to the 5-day low of $130.00 indicates a Higher Low pattern formation.
